disambiguation: Not a general note sync tool; it is specifically designed to sync TTRPG campaign notes to the RoleCall game platform.
intentEvidence: Sync your Published/ notes to a Role Call game.
problem: Game masters need a way to keep their detailed preparation notes private while making campaign content accessible to players on an external platform.

relations.evidence: Sync your Published/ notes to a Role Call game.

summary: RoleCall Sync synchronizes TTRPG campaign notes and embedded media between Obsidian and the RoleCall game platform, managing public and GM-only content.
